known.via: English Wikipedia "Cviček" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Slovenian wine from Lower Carniola, unusual for blending white and red grapes. Long known as a sour, poor wine, it has become popular with locals and visitors.
